::: {.notes}
Select a model to open its card. The following slide contains its example. Links at the foot of each domain open the comparisons. All models in the header returns to this catalog.

The map preserves the original five disclosure categories. Known means a specific detail is public. Partial means the evidence covers only part of the category or only one variant. A dashed outline marks material the cited sources leave undisclosed. The last speech category is voice and control. The corner mark indicates available weights for at least one named variant. Each card identifies the applicable variant, licence and source.

The original 40-card index used the October disclosure workbooks for LLM, text-to-image, text-to-video, speech and music. The GLM-5.4 entry follows the 23 November Z.ai release and its model guide.
:::
